error.unable_to_calibrate:
The calibration process has encountered an issue and could not be completed successfully. Please ensure that your heating system is functioning properly and that all required sensors are connected and working correctly.

If you continue to experience issues with calibration, consider contacting us for further assistance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

progress.calibration:

areas.description: Settings related to thermostat, multi-room and temperature control. The radiators are in the same room as the inside sensor and the rooms have their own target temperatures separate from the system.
areas.title: Areas

automatic_gains.description:
This feature adjusts the control parameters of your heating system dynamically, optimizing temperature control for better comfort and energy efficiency. Enabling this option allows SAT to continuously adapt and fine-tune the heating settings based on the environmental conditions. This helps maintain a stable and comfortable environment without manual intervention.

Note: If you choose not to enable automatic gains, you will need to manually enter the PID values for precise temperature control. Please ensure that you have accurate PID values for your specific heating system to achieve optimal performance.
automatic_gains.title: Automatic Gains

calibrate_system.description:
Optimize your heating system by automatically determining the optimal PID values for your setup. When selecting Automatic Gains, please note that the system will go through a calibration process that may take approximately 20 minutes to complete.

Automatic Gains is recommended for most users as it simplifies the setup process and ensures optimal performance. However, if you're familiar with PID control and prefer to manually set the values, you can choose to skip Automatic Gains.

Please note that choosing to skip Automatic Gains requires a good understanding of PID control and may require additional manual adjustments to achieve optimal performance.

menu_options.calibrate: Calibrate and determine your overshoot protection value (approx. 20 min).
menu_options.overshoot_protection: Manually enter the overshoot protection value.

calibrate_system.title: Calibrate System

calibrated.description:
The calibration process has completed successfully.

Congratulations! Your Smart Autotune Thermostat (SAT) has been calibrated to optimize the heating performance of your system. During the calibration process, SAT carefully analyzed the heating characteristics and determined the appropriate overshoot protection value to ensure precise temperature control.

Overshoot Protection Value: {minimum_setpoint} °C

This value represents the maximum amount of overshoot allowed during the heating process. SAT will actively monitor and adjust the heating to prevent excessive overshooting, maintaining a comfortable and efficient heating experience in your home.

Please note that the overshoot protection value may vary depending on the specific characteristics of your heating system and environmental factors. It has been fine-tuned to provide optimal performance based on the calibration results.
calibrated.title: Calibration Completed

overshoot_protection.description:
By providing the overshoot protection value, SAT will adjust the control parameters accordingly to maintain a stable and comfortable heating environment. This manual configuration allows you to fine-tune the system based on your specific setup.

Note: If you are unsure about the overshoot protection value or have not performed the calibration process, it is recommended to cancel the configuration and go through the calibration process to let SAT automatically determine the value for optimal performance.

serial.description:
To establish a connection with the OpenTherm Gateway using a socket connection, please provide the following details. In the Name field, enter a name for the gateway that will help you identify it within your system.

Specify the network address of the OpenTherm Gateway in the Device field. This could be in the format of "socket://otgw.local:25238", where "otgw.local" is the hostname or IP address of the gateway and "25238" is the port number.

These settings are essential for establishing communication and integration with your OpenTherm Gateway through the socket connection. Ensure that the provided details are accurate to ensure proper functionality.
serial.title: OpenTherm Gateway ( SERIAL )

simulator.description:
This gateway allows you to simulate a boiler for testing and demonstration purposes. Please provide the following information to configure the simulator.

Note: The Simulator Gateway is intended for testing and demonstration purposes only and should not be used in production environments.
simulator.title: Simulated Gateway ( ADVANCED )

switch.description:
Please fill in the following details to set up the switch. Enter a name for the switch in the Name field, which will help you identify it within your system. Choose the appropriate entity to use for your switch from the provided options.

In the Temperature Setting field, specify the desired target temperature for your heating system. If you are using a hot water boiler, fill in the Boiler Temperature Setting with the appropriate value. For electric heating systems, enter the value 100.

These settings are essential for precise temperature control and ensuring optimal performance of your heating system. Providing the correct Temperature Setting allows for accurate regulation and helps achieve a comfortable and energy-efficient environment in your home.
switch.title: PID Thermostat with PWM ( ON/OFF )

data_description.thermal_comfort: Enable the use of the Simmer Index for thermal comfort adjustment.

data_description.overshoot_protection: Enable overshoot protection with Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) to prevent boiler temperature overshooting.

xtreme_profile.title: Xtreme profile (fork)
xtreme_profile.description: This page belongs to SAT-xtreme, an unofficial fork of SAT, not to the official SAT. Every option is off by default; with everything off, SAT behaves like the official version. Turn on one option at a time and watch the effect for a few days.

thermostat.name: Thermostat on the bus
thermostat.description: For an OpenTherm Gateway with a thermostat (for example a Nest) still connected to the boiler.

data.xtreme_prime_setpoint: Keep the setpoint ready between PWM blocks
data.xtreme_handover_on_off: Hand over to the thermostat when SAT is turned off

data_description.xtreme_prime_setpoint: Between PWM blocks SAT normally lowers the setpoint to 10 °C. With a thermostat on the bus the new setpoint then reaches the boiler late (with a Nest up to 2.5 minutes), so every block loses burn time. With this on, the setpoint stays at the overshoot protection value and only the heating demand is turned off, so the boiler starts within seconds.
data_description.xtreme_handover_on_off: When you turn the SAT thermostat off, the gateway hands control back to the thermostat on the bus right away (CS=0), instead of after about a minute. If Home Assistant stops, the gateway still does this after about a minute. Only for the OpenTherm Gateway over MQTT.

boiler.name: Boiler
boiler.description: Settings for your boiler. Take the values from the rating plate and the installation manual of your boiler, or choose a preset.

data.xtreme_ignore_modulation_limit: The boiler ignores the modulation limit
data.xtreme_anti_cycling_margin: Extra margin on the anti-cycling time
data.xtreme_minimum_burn_time: Minimum burn time per PWM block
data.xtreme_minimum_duty_cycle: Do not heat below this duty cycle

data_description.xtreme_boiler_preset: Fills in the heating output and anti-cycling time of a known boiler. It never turns an option on or off. When you change one of these values yourself, the preset goes back to Custom.
data_description.xtreme_ignore_modulation_limit: Turn on when your boiler does not follow the maximum modulation that SAT sends (MM=), but does report its modulation. SAT then stops sending the limit and keeps using the reported modulation. On an OpenTherm Gateway you can recognise this in the log: message 14 is answered with Data-Invalid.
data_description.xtreme_boiler_maximum_power: Rated heating output for central heating (Pn at 80/60 °C), maximum, from the rating plate. Only used for the power sensor when the boiler does not report its capacity.
data_description.xtreme_boiler_minimum_power: Rated heating output for central heating (Pn at 80/60 °C), minimum, from the rating plate. Only used for the power sensor when the boiler does not report its minimum.
data_description.xtreme_boiler_timing: PWM counts real burn time instead of time since the heating demand, waits for the anti-cycling time after every flame (also short hot water flames), and burns at least the minimum burn time. Fill in the anti-cycling time below first.
data_description.xtreme_anti_cycling_time: How long your boiler waits before it starts again after switching off. See the installation manual (for example parameter P036 on Intergas, HG09 on Wolf). Only used with 'Align PWM with the boiler'.
data_description.xtreme_anti_cycling_margin: Seconds added to the anti-cycling time, so SAT never asks for heat just before the boiler may start.
data_description.xtreme_minimum_burn_time: The shortest burn of a PWM block. Longer burns mean fewer starts and longer pauses. Default 6 minutes.
data_description.xtreme_minimum_duty_cycle: When the house needs less heat than this share of the time, SAT does not heat at all until the demand rises. Default 7.5 %.
data_description.xtreme_hot_water_switch: Adds the switch 'Xtreme fork: Hot Water Keep Warm'. On: normal operation (HW=A): the DHW enable bit follows the thermostat on the bus, so the boiler keeps hot water warm as set on the boiler (comfort or eco). Off (HW=0): no keep-warm, fewer short burner starts, but hot water takes longer to arrive at the tap. Use it by hand or in an automation, for example off at night. The gateway keeps the last setting, also when Home Assistant is down. Test first that hot water still works at the tap with the switch off: some boilers block hot water completely (only tested with an Intergas Xtreme 30). Turning this option off gives keep-warm back to the boiler. OpenTherm Gateway over MQTT only.

learning.name: Learning and calibration
learning.description: Find the overshoot protection value (OPV): the lowest flow temperature at which your boiler burns steadily at minimum power.

data_description.xtreme_learned_opv: SAT learns the OPV during normal heating. 'Learn only' shows the learned value in a sensor while SAT keeps using your own OPV. 'Learn and apply' lets SAT use the learned value.
data_description.xtreme_calibration: Adds a start and stop button and a status sensor for a careful calibration of the OPV. It first tests for about 10 minutes whether the boiler follows the modulation limit. If it does, each of the 5 rounds measures at minimum power (about 2 hours in total). If not, each round lowers the setpoint step by step (usually 5 to 6 hours; longer in mild weather, because the calibration pauses while the room is more than 1 °C above the target; at most 10 hours). It pauses for hot water and can be stopped at any time. The result becomes the starting value of the self-learning OPV.

pid_settings.title: PID settings (fork)
pid_settings.description: This page belongs to SAT-xtreme, an unofficial fork of SAT, not to the official SAT. SAT calculates the water temperature as: heating curve + correction (PID). Here you choose how strong that correction is.

data.xtreme_maximum_setpoint_rise: Maximum rise above the heating curve

data_description.automatic_gains: SAT calculates the strength of the correction from the heating curve. Turn off to enter kP, kI and kD yourself on the next page; it is prefilled with the values SAT uses now.
data_description.xtreme_pid_gain_factor: Makes the automatic correction calmer (below 1.0) or stronger (above 1.0). For example 0.5: a room that is 1 °C too cold makes the water about half as hot extra. 1.0 = unchanged. Not used with manual gains.
data_description.xtreme_maximum_setpoint_rise: The water never gets more than this hotter than the heating curve. 0 = no limit. Note: this also slows down warming up in the morning.

manual_gains.title: Manual gains (fork)
manual_gains.description: This page belongs to SAT-xtreme, an unofficial fork of SAT, not to the official SAT. The fields are prefilled with the values SAT uses now, so saving them unchanged does not change the control.

data_description.proportional: How strongly SAT reacts to the difference between the room and the target: °C of extra water temperature per °C that the room is too cold.
data_description.integral: How fast SAT removes a small difference that remains over time. SAT only uses this part when the room is within 0.1 °C of the target.
data_description.derivative: How strongly SAT reacts to how fast the room temperature changes. It brakes when the room warms up quickly and helps when it cools down quickly.

reset_integral.name: Reset Integral
reset_integral.description: This service resets the integrating part of the PID controller for the specified climate entity. This may be useful if the integral value has become too large or if the PID controller's performance has degraded.

pulse_width_modulation.name: Pulse Width Modulation
pulse_width_modulation.description: Force enable or disable the Pulse Width Modulation, do note that it may be turned on or off automatically right after again.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: The state you want to force.

start_xtreme_calibration.name: Start Xtreme calibration (fork)
start_xtreme_calibration.description: SAT-xtreme: start the slow calibration of the overshoot protection value.

stop_xtreme_calibration.name: Stop Xtreme calibration (fork)
stop_xtreme_calibration.description: SAT-xtreme: stop the calibration and return to normal operation.

create_xtreme_dashboard.name: Create Xtreme dashboard (fork)
create_xtreme_dashboard.description: SAT-xtreme: create or rebuild the SAT Xtreme dashboard with the entities that exist now.

ignores_modulation_limit.title: The boiler ignores the modulation limit

confirm.title: Turn on 'The boiler ignores the modulation limit'?
confirm.description: During the calibration SAT-xtreme set the maximum modulation to 0 %, but the boiler kept modulating at about {modulation} %. Boilers like this do not follow the modulation limit (MM=). With the option 'The boiler ignores the modulation limit' on, SAT stops sending the limit and keeps using the reported modulation. Submit to turn the option on; SAT reloads. Ignore this repair to leave everything as it is.

confirm.title: Create the SAT Xtreme dashboard?
confirm.description: SAT-xtreme can create a dashboard 'SAT Xtreme' in the sidebar with the state of the boiler, graphs of the last hours, the PID correction, the PWM blocks, the learned OPV and the calibration. It uses the entities of this SAT, whatever they are called, and only shows cards for the features you use. Submit to create it. Later you can rebuild it with the button 'Xtreme fork: Create Dashboard' (for example after turning on a feature); that only changes the SAT Xtreme dashboard.
